newsitem.title: JAPAN: Indonesia, Japan central bankers to cooperate - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia, Japan central bankers to cooperate - BOJ.

text.p: Indonesia's central bank governor and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor said they would cooperate closely in financial markets when they discussed Asian currency markets in a meeting on Monday afternoon, Takashi Anzai, BOJ executive director, told reporters.

"The BOJ and the Indonesian central bank agreed to maintain close cooperation in various areas," Anzai told reporters. He declined to give any details about those areas in which the two intended to cooperate.
Anzai said that, at the meeting between Indonesian central bank Governor Sudradjad Djiwandono and BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita, Djiwandono made no specific request of the BOJ.
Anzai also said there was no specific discussion about using the repo pact, which was established last year to ensure liquidity in Asian currency markets in order to fend off speculative attacks.
Anzai declined to comment on how the BOJ views the current situation in the Asian currency markets.
